events.title: HK Info Night Online
events.description:
The lights are soft, the spotlight is waiting, and your HK era might be closer than you think. ♡₊˚

Ever wondered what Hoa Khoi Lien Truong (HK) is all about? Whether you’re curious about the experience, what being a contestant involves, or what you can gain from participating, come join us for an HK Info Night!

This opportunity is open to female-identifying members of VSAUW! ♡ Whether you’re considering becoming a contestant or simply want to learn more, come with your questions and a little curiosity. Learn about the show, meet others who are interested, and discover what this experience could look like for you. ✧

✦ INFO NIGHT #1: IN-PERSON
♡ Date: Monday, November 2nd
♡ Time: 6:00–7:00 PM
♡ Location: SAV 168

✦ INFO NIGHT #2: ONLINE
♡ Date: Friday, November 6th
♡ Time: 9:00–10:00 PM
♡ Location: Zoom Link Through LinkTree

Both sessions will cover the same information, so choose whichever works best for you. However, YOU MUST ATTEND ONE INFO SESSION to qualify for HK.

If you’ve been curious about HK, consider this your sign to come learn more. Your next chapter might be waiting in the spotlight. ⋆౨ৎ˚⟡˖

We can’t wait to see you there! ♡

Graphics By: Kaitlyn Liu
#vsauw

events.description:

events.title: Family Weekend Fun
events.description: Hey Huskies! Join us this Friday at the ECC for a family weekend fun event! We’ll have food, a photobooth, and a cute picture frame decorating activity! See you there :)

events.title: Product Games
events.description:
Get ready for THE PRODUCT GAMES! 🚀🎯🏹

Registration is now OPEN for The Product Games, a one-day product competition combining the strategy of a case competition with the rapid building of a hackathon! 

Work in teams of 4 to tackle a real-world product challenge, build an innovative solution, and pitch your ideas to industry judges! Plus, enjoy free food, swag, mentorship, networking opportunities, and a chance to win prizes! 🏆

Event Details:
📅 Date: Saturday, November 7 | 9 AM – 5:30 PM
📍 Location: Founders Hall, UW
👥 Eligibility: Open to all UW students, regardless of major or experience
🔗 Applications are OPEN NOW, and close October 26 at 11:59 PM

Spots are limited, so don’t miss your chance! Apply through the link in our bio or scan the QR code to register!

events.title: Let’s Talk Drop-in
events.description:
Midterms are here and we see you 👀💜

Here are a few things that actually help: study in short bursts, get some sleep (seriously), and don’t be afraid to ask for help. Swipe for our full survival guide and where to find support at UW.

If things feel heavy, you can talk to someone. Let’s Talk drop-ins are every Tuesday from 2-4 pm right here at the Kelly ECC, and the Husky HelpLine is open 24/7 at 206-616-7777.

And you don’t have to study alone. Come hang out and study with us at the ECC 🦋

Save this for later and send it to a friend who needs it. You’ve got this, Huskies! 🐾

#UWLWB #KellyECC #UWMidterms #HuskyWellbeing #StudyTips

events.description:
‼️RSVP on all sides is closed, we received 150 sign up in 24 hours we do not have any more space‼️

🧡 Intro to Claude Code 🧡

CBC, NSBE, SHPE, and ColorStack are teaming up to show you how to build with Claude Code, an AI coding agent that works right alongside you.

What’s happening:

→ Learn what Claude Code can do
→ See live demos
→ Get hands-on and build with it yourself

🎁 Free Claude Pro + Uber One for attendees
☕ Food and drinks from Starbucks and Uber Eats

📅 Monday, Nov. 9

Massive Variety: A wide selection of trusted vendors, local artists, and exclusive finds.
